subject: fix(evals): make publication transactional
base_source: rs-25844ce3: the clean variant is copied from it; the seeded variant adds one defect

clean.description: The change as committed. No defect is planted.

seeded.seed: in publishDiagnostic, the destination-exists refusal was removed
seeded.description: publishDiagnostic refuses to publish when the destination already exists. The seed removes that check. Renaming onto an existing empty directory then succeeds, so an earlier diagnostic placeholder is replaced and reported as published.
seeded.consequence: A diagnostic is reported as published over an existing destination directory. The earlier record at that path is replaced without a failure.
